description: Defines the TextFragment class and related iterator for handling text segments, including substring operations, comparisons, and delimiters.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment of text with methods for comparison, trimming, and substring operations.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing segments of a TextFragment based on delimiters.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Helper class within TextFragment for managing substring indices.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the TextFragment to an empty state.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison with another TextFragment, TCHAR array, or string.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the first character matches given characters.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the TextFragment is empty.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns length of the text segment.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the start of the text data.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the text as a string.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares text with another TextFragment or TCHAR array, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds position of delimiter forward from offset.

methods.name: ForwardSkip
methods.description: Skips characters until delimiter not found.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds position of delimiter backward from offset.

methods.name: ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips characters backward until delimiter not found.
